title: Hodge Conjecture Finite Verification Suite: Spin(8) Triality, O(2,4) Kuga-Satake Schur Splits, Mumford CM Cycles, and Bridge Lemmas H1-H2
description: Zero-Axiom Finite-Dimensional and Parameterized Bridge Certification in Lean 4 (42+ modules, 208+ declarations, zero custom axioms) for Hodge Conjecture testbeds on sextic Calabi-Yau fourfolds and Mumford spinor sixfolds, including O(2,4)/Spin(2,4) Kuga-Satake Schur splits (1152 floor), 2*Z_CM = T_ch, HodgeClayConditionsStage1to3Cert, HodgeClayAllGapsAttemptCert, and Papers 1-6. In this work, ai is being used as a tool by Qamar Munawer (Brandenburg University of Technology Cottbus-Senftenberg).
notes: Zero-Axiom Finite-Dimensional and Parameterized Bridge Certification in Lean 4 (DOI reference: 10.5281/zenodo.24381741). Reproduce locally with `python verify_zenodo_deposit.py` and `pytest -q`.
